Sample SD measures observed variability; CV is SD/mean; SEM is SD/sqrt(n), not a prediction interval. Quantiles use linear interpolation. Missing historical measurements are marked —. Timing covers candidate execution, excluding instrumentation output and candidate initialization; total solver time includes process launch, parsing, initialization, reporting and output. RSS is Linux process-wide peak memory at candidate completion, not memory owned by that algorithm; later rows inherit earlier peaks. Runtime is measured, asymptotic complexity is not.
